summary: Phase 1 Investment Calculator end-to-end verification PASSED. Backend (public + admin) API, admin web panel (sidebar + AdminCalculatorConfig page), and mobile (Invest tab CTA → /invest/calculator with 4 tabs, reinvest toggle, validation, SVG growth chart, back-to-invest CTA) all working. 7/7 pytest tests passed; admin panel save+revert worked; mobile compute & validation verified.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native web warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow"'. Multiple call sites in calculator.tsx (tabs at ~191, results card at ~228, CTA shadow at ~262) and invest.tsx (CTA card). Non-blocking on native; web-only deprecation warning. Reference: /app/frontend/app/invest/calculator.tsx:191, 228, 242

Console warning 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation' — comes from upstream libs on web preview; informational only.

action_items: (Optional polish) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow on calculator.tsx and invest.tsx CTA card to silence RN-Web warnings.

(Optional) Add startup seed_config() call for calculator_config in server.py startup hook so the doc exists in DB on first boot (currently get_config falls back to DEFAULTS, which is functionally fine but inconsistent with tier_config that is seeded).
critical_code_review_comments: calculator_config.py: seed_config() is defined but never called from server.py startup. Public GET still works via DEFAULTS fallback, but seeding at boot would make admin GET return a persisted doc immediately.

Validation in update_cfg only checks min vs max when BOTH are present in the request; if a partial PUT sets min_amount=2000000 with existing max_amount=1000000, it will silently store an invalid range. Suggest fetching current doc to validate against effective values. Reference: /app/backend/calculator_config.py:83
Mobile calculator.tsx falls back to (minAmt=100, maxAmt=1000000) before cfg loads but ActivityIndicator gates rendering, so this is dead code — fine.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests are idempotent — they read current admin cfg, mutate, verify, and restore to original values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_calculator.py covers public GET, admin GET (auth + no-auth), PUT persistence, and both validation rules (min>=max & return_min>=return_max). Admin login uses POST /api/admin/auth/login. Mobile login via /login screen uses identifier+password (first 2 inputs). Invest CTA testID='calculator-cta'. Calculator screen testIDs: tab-{onetime|sip|daily|compound}, calc-amount, calc-duration, calc-rate, reinvest-toggle, start-invest-btn, back-btn.
